source.recipe: LeagueOS_Blue WSL2 distro (native WSL git checkouts bind-mounted into Docker, not /mnt/c/) — no standalone export recipe file exists yet; this descriptor records the running instance's shape, not a reproducible build script.
source.provenance: PFM AGENTS.md's 'LeagueOS daily staging workflows' section — the real, currently-running four-container 2x2 grid serving LeagueOS demo/candidate traffic.

supportedTarget: WSL2 on Windows 11, LeagueOS_Blue distro, its own Docker daemon

isolation.composeProject: leagueos-staging-anon, leagueos-staging-synth, leagueos-candidate-anon, leagueos-candidate-synth (four real Compose projects under one WSL distro/Docker daemon — this descriptor covers the whole LeagueOS_Blue instance, not a single project; see note below)

_note: Real confirmed facts (hostPorts, bindMounts, the four Compose project names, the distro name) come from PFM AGENTS.md's 'LeagueOS daily staging workflows' section. The 5 isolation fields that were 'unknown — needs verification' in the v1.0.0 version of this descriptor were verified live by AO_WSL on 2026-10-08 via `docker info`/`docker network inspect`/`docker network ls`/`docker volume ls` against LeagueOS_Blue's actual running daemon: dockerDataRoot is the Docker default (/var/lib/docker, never overridden on this daemon); bridge/addressPool/networks are one real value PER Compose project (4 of each) rather than one daemon-wide value — this is exactly why contract v1.1 widened bridge/addressPool from a single string to an array. Two non-core networks/volumes exist on the same daemon (leagueos-static-preview_default, leagueos-bisect-0920_*, bernoulli-568-e2e_integration-*) and are deliberately NOT listed here since they belong to other, non-permanent instances, not this descriptor's 4 core stacks — a future descriptor should cover those separately if they become durable.
